visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair, wearing a white T-shirt with a rainbow graphic and a plaid shirt draped over his shoulders, leans toward the camera, smiling and gesturing with his hands framing his face. The background shows a white car parked in an urban area. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor street where the man and a woman with rainbow arm sleeves are walking. They are both holding signs with the word 'GAP' in rainbow colors. The street is lined with trees and a crowd of people is visible in the background. (3) The man is now standing on a parade float decorated with a large rainbow-colored sphere balloon. He holds a microphone and waves to the crowd. The side of the truck features large text and a rainbow stripe. (4) A montage follows showing various participants in a parade. Some carry a massive rainbow flag, while others wear colorful costumes or hold umbrellas. The man interacts with the crowd from the truck, smiling and flashing peace signs. (5) The weather changes, and rain is visible on the camera lens. The man stands on the street amidst the crowd, gesturing with his hands to form a heart shape while looking directly at the camera. The background remains a busy city street with people walking under umbrellas.
